name: Colored initial noise (power-law alpha presets)
plain: A NOISE source that draws white noise on CPU in the same order as core prepare_noise (so batch_index subsets match), then shapes each batch item separately with the radial power-law filter and rescales it to zero mean and unit std times energy_scale. Presets: white 0, pink 1, brown 2, blue −1, violet −2, or a custom alpha. ColoredNoise_KSampler uses the same source when color_initial_noise is on, with alpha_start as the exponent.
math:
Symbols: ε per-item white noise; r radial frequency bin in [0,1].
A(r)=max(r,1/512)^(−α/2), A(0)=0 for α>0.
n_i = energy · Z(Re ifft2(fft2(ε_i)·A(r))) per batch item i.
